dataset.scene_split: train seeds 0/1 only; evaluation seeds 2/3 remain disjoint

ordinary_pi05.description: ordinary pi0.5 fine-tuning on every accepted query-action chunk

terminal_outcome.formula: exp((terminal_success - task_mean_terminal_success) / 1.0), normalized to task mean one
terminal_outcome.claim_limit: episode-level terminal-outcome weighting, not action advantage or Q-value

outcome_free_crave.formula: exp((CRAVE_progress_next_query - CRAVE_progress_current_query - task_mean_delta) / 1.0), normalized to task mean one
outcome_free_crave.teacher: frozen demonstration-derived DINOv3-base CRAVE recurrence field
outcome_free_crave.terminal_query_policy: the last query without a next observation receives neutral raw weight before task normalization

matching_invariants: All arms start from the exact SidneyXie/pi05_robotwin public checkpoint.
All arms consume the identical ordered 6313 samples and use the same seed, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, update count, and augmentation settings.
Only the per-sample loss weighter differs across arms.
The CRAVE label process may read only the outcome-stripped query manifest, query-time cam_high images, and the frozen demonstration-derived CRAVE teacher.
Every sidecar row must exactly match task, scene_seed, query_index, and query_frame in the action-chunk artifact.
No R4 training is authorized by this data-preparation protocol alone.

screening_recipe.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step 5000; no evaluation-based checkpoint selection
screening_recipe.replication: seeds 1001 and 1002 only after the seed-1000 terminal-outcome arm exceeds both matched controls
